CuMesh.js -- pure-JS mesh simplifier

Runs entirely in this tab (no server, no upload) -- a JS/typed-array port of CuMesh's batched parallel edge-collapse decimator (see source/cmp_ext_turing/third_party/CuMesh_py for the Python version this mirrors). Pick a .glb, choose a target, and simplify.

Pick a .glb file to begin.
